create_thread_metadata: create a new thread with assistant_id, display_name, and metadata in the ThreadMetaStore
get_thread_metadata: get the metadata dict for an existing thread_id from the ThreadMetaStore
search_threads: search threads by metadata filters, status, limit, and offset via ThreadMetaStore
update_thread_display_name: update the display_name of an existing thread in the ThreadMetaStore
update_thread_metadata: merge new metadata key-value pairs into an existing thread via ThreadMetaStore
